hotels.title: Stylish Melbourne Flinders Lane Escape in the Heart of the CBD
hotels.description: Set on Melbourne’s celebrated Flinders Lane, this polished apartment-style retreat places you in the heart of the CBD, moments from Hosier Lane’s street art and the boutiques of Collins Street. Federation Square, the Yarra River promenade and the Princess Theatre are all within easy walking distance. Spacious studios and apartments feature kitchenettes or full kitchens, laundry facilities and contemporary interiors designed for longer city stays. Nearby, dine on refined Japanese at Kisumé, discover modern Thai at Chin Chin or slip into the laneway bars and wine rooms that define this storied neighbourhood
